title: The porter learns replacements that span calls, and moves into the game's libraries
text: Two blockers left after step 58. Many-to-one rewrites: the game merged tesselator.getBuilder() and builder.begin(mode, format) into tesselator.begin(mode, format) (1.21), and tesselator.end() became BufferUploader.drawWithShader(builder.buildOrThrow()). Two changed calls on one value, or a call on the receiver an earlier changed call used, are learned as one replacement over both calls' operands, from the same lined-up game code; PortChains rewrites the pair in a mod's class into one stand-in call JarPort compiles. And the link check never read the game's own libraries, so 1.19.3's move of com.mojang.math to JOML could not link: each release's library jars are read too, the class map may point into them, and the moved class's members are learned through it.
finish: port.jar-links.every-update up from 5,854 of 9,423 with no update lower, and load on NeoForge 1.20.6 -> 1.21 and Fabric 1.19.2 -> 1.19.3 (server) showing every linked standalone mod loads
wrongIf: an update's count drops, or a mod that links only through a learned chain or a library class map fails to load because of it
result: 2026-11-20: port.jar-links.every-update 5,838 -> 5,846 of 9,423 (main as recorded after #135), better on 6 updates (Fabric 1.20.6 -> 1.21 52 -> 55, 1.19.2 -> 1.19.3 37 -> 39, NeoForge 1.20.6 -> 1.21 58 -> 60, 1.21.4 -> 1.21.5 33 -> 35). Three updates are 1 lower, each a library change the old link check never read: DataFixerUpper on 1.19.4 and 1.20.5 (main's port of Resourceful Config links but crashes on a real 1.20.5 server with NoClassDefFoundError DataResult$PartialResult) and authlib's GameProfile.getId() on 1.21.9. Real NeoForge 1.21 server: 32 of 36 linked standalone mods load, 3 client-only; Necronomicon (a Forge-only mods.toml) fails as on main; client 33 of 35 (FerriteCore as on main; InventoryHUD+, new here, trips on NeoForge 1.21 loading client configs before client setup). Real Fabric 1.19.3 server: 8 of 14 load, 4 client-only, FerriteCore and MemoryLeakFix fail as on main. Next: lambdas in a learned expression (DataResult.error(String) is error(() -> s)), getOrThrow-style replacements that depend on a constant argument, and the record-accessor renames a vote misses (GameProfile.getId()).
